name: Pre-funded cross-exchange kimchi-premium spatial arbitrage
author: Journal of Data Forensics Research
instruments: same crypto asset on offshore exchange and Korean exchange

indicators.premium: KRW domestic asset quote vs FX-converted offshore quote

entry_long: If premium is positive enough after fees, buy offshore and sell Korean leg
entry_short: If premium is negative enough after costs, buy Korean and sell offshore
exit: Close paired legs when price gap converges; threshold not specified
position_sizing: Equal asset notional across two venues
filters: Needs pre-funded accounts; withdrawal and capital-control constraints
claimed_performance: Article describes mechanics and structural frictions, not a tested parameterized signal.
implementation_notes: Do not interpret as executable arbitrage absent transfer, fee, FX, settlement, inventory and legal constraints.
